question_text: Has a biodiversity baseline assessment been completed for the project area?
clarification_text: Baseline means understanding key habitats, species pressure, and ecosystem services before project commitment.
recommendation_yes: Ensure baseline is updated when project boundaries or design assumptions change.
recommendation_no: Start with a baseline screening before investment committee decision.
recommendation_unknown: Assign an owner to confirm whether baseline analysis exists.

question_text: Is the baseline expected to be completed before financial close?
clarification_text: This conditional sub-question appears when baseline status is not confirmed.
recommendation_yes: Track delivery date in project governance milestones.
recommendation_no: High risk: include biodiversity baseline as a pre-condition for approval.
recommendation_unknown: Escalate to project sponsor for immediate clarification.

question_text: Does the project include a no-net-loss or net-positive biodiversity objective?
clarification_text: Objective can be policy-level or project-level but should be auditable.
recommendation_yes: Define KPIs and periodic monitoring against the objective.
recommendation_no: Set a proportionate biodiversity target linked to project impacts.
recommendation_unknown: Check environmental permit commitments and financing covenants.

question_text: Have critical ecosystem dependencies been identified for this investment?
clarification_text: Dependencies include water quality, pollination, soil health, and coastal protection.
recommendation_yes: Link dependencies to risk controls and stewardship plans.
recommendation_no: Run a dependency screen and document top three material dependencies.
recommendation_unknown: Collect minimum input data for an initial ENCORE pass.

question_text: Are local or indigenous communities included in project decision-making?
clarification_text: Inclusion should be meaningful and documented, not only one-off consultation.
recommendation_yes: Record engagement outcomes and feedback loops in governance documents.
recommendation_no: Create a formal stakeholder engagement plan before next project gate.
recommendation_unknown: Validate if consultation has happened and at what quality level.

question_text: Is there a grievance mechanism available to affected communities?
clarification_text: Mechanism should be accessible, documented, and track resolution timelines.
recommendation_yes: Publish grievance process and performance metrics annually.
recommendation_no: Design a grievance mechanism with clear SLA and escalation path.
recommendation_unknown: Assign accountability for community feedback and disputes.

question_text: Has a nature-related site risk screening been completed for this property?
clarification_text: Risk screening should cover proximity to protected areas and flood or heat stress.
recommendation_yes: Integrate findings into asset management and capex planning.
recommendation_no: Run a basic site risk screening before transaction finalization.
recommendation_unknown: Confirm with transaction team whether a screening exists.

question_text: Are biodiversity-enhancing design features included in project plans?
clarification_text: Examples: native planting, green roofs, ecological corridors, permeable landscaping.
recommendation_yes: Set measurable biodiversity outcomes for post-completion monitoring.
recommendation_no: Review low-cost design changes to reduce habitat fragmentation.
recommendation_unknown: Ask design team to provide current biodiversity feature list.

question_text: Is biodiversity performance reported to governance or investment committees?
clarification_text: Reporting can be quarterly dashboards or formal committee papers.
recommendation_yes: Include trend indicators and management actions in reporting packs.
recommendation_no: Define minimum reporting cadence and assign data owner.
recommendation_unknown: Map existing governance forums and current ESG reporting scope.
